title: workspaces schema
description: FortiPi protocol 1.0 / schema 1.0.0. Known records are closed. Cross-field authority and temporal predicates are enforced by the owning consumer; see the contract README.

RelativePath.title: RelativePath
RelativePath.description: NFC normalized valid UTF-8 relative POSIX path, at most1024 UTF-8 bytes. validateRelativePath additionally enforces byte length and normalization; filesystem adapters must enforce no-follow/race checks.

blobs.description: Required for local uploads, including an explicit empty array when no put is declared. If supplied, covers each distinct put SHA exactly once, including superseded puts. Computer uploads may omit it.

UploadCommit.title: UploadCommit
UploadCommit.description: Public commit of a validated upload. Authority resolves stageId, validates its private seal/local observation and computes commitDigest. Exact request retries recover the original receipt; callers never supply child IDs.

SealedStoreReference.title: SealedStoreReference
SealedStoreReference.description: Opaque authority-issued stage identity; never a child Durable Object ID or routing capability.

UploadBlobPlan.title: UploadBlobPlan
UploadBlobPlan.description: One announced chunk inventory for a distinct declared put content hash. Byte size comes from its put mutations.

WorkspaceOperationLease.title: WorkspaceOperationLease
WorkspaceOperationLease.description: Existing non-job Lease wire variant; no new fields. Job identity is forbidden.
